purpose: Implement Company OS F1.1: one machine-verifiable authorization and audit classification for every /staff endpoint, fail CI on omissions or contradictions, and close the registration review list session-boundary gap without creating new standing privilege.
requiredInvariants: Every route exposed by StaffAccessController, StaffCapabilitiesController and StaffWorkspaceController has exactly one source-controlled authorization class and one audit class.
The classification gate is server-side source authority and is verified against actual Nest route, guard, mode and permission metadata.
Actor-only authority discovery remains usable before a privileged staff access session exists and cannot accept cross-user, tenant or organization selectors.
Actor-owned access request, grant activation and own-session termination remain self-governance operations and cannot target another actor.
Break-glass lifecycle remains a distinct emergency class and is never downgraded to ordinary self-mutation classification.
Privileged routes retain StaffAccessGuard, explicit StaffAccessMode and exact StaffPermission boundaries.

The registration application review list is brought behind an active CONTROL_PLANE session with STAFF_REQUEST_READ; durable role-ceiling checks alone are not accepted as the privileged session boundary.
No new staff role or permission is introduced.
No database schema, migration, Caddy, DNS, Compose, secret or production mutation is included.
Merge, CI and image build are not production deployment evidence.
acceptance: The registry/checker enumerates all current /staff routes and fails on missing or duplicate classification.
The checker fails when a privileged classification disagrees with actual guard, mode or permission metadata.
The checker fails when a self-authority route contains dynamic target selectors or is widened beyond its exact actor-only path.
Critical and emergency routes cannot be classified as standard reads or ordinary mutations.
Registration review list and decision both require current CONTROL_PLANE session authority with their exact permissions.
Negative fixtures prove an unclassified endpoint and contradictory policy are rejected.
Exact-head API typecheck, unit tests, RLS, security and CI pass before merge.
No new recurring cost is introduced.
